notes: The list covers nearly all of Wieniawski's published violin works. The main gaps are the two early duos for violin and piano written with his brother Józef, Op. 2 and Op. 8. I left out lost works (e.g. Fantaisie pastorale, Op. 13), the viola Rêverie, and individual études from Op. 10 and Op. 18, which the database keeps as whole sets.
